definitions.explanation: The minimum amount of energy the body needs to maintain basic life functions at rest, such as breathing, circulation, and cell production.

examples.japanese: {基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}を{上|あ}げるには{筋肉|きんにく}をつけるといい。
examples.english: Building muscle is a good way to raise your basal metabolism.

examples.japanese: {年齢|ねんれい}とともに{基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}は{下|さ}がる。
ダイエットで{食事|しょくじ}を{減|へ}らしすぎると{基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}が{落|お}ちて、{逆|ぎゃく}に{太|ふと}りやすくなる。
examples.english: If you reduce your food intake too much when dieting, your basal metabolism drops and you actually become more likely to gain weight.

notes:
USAGE:
A common topic in health, fitness, and dieting discussions. Often abbreviated to {基礎代謝量|きそたいしゃりょう} (basal metabolic rate) in more technical contexts. The concept is widely discussed in Japanese health media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}を{上|あ}げる (to raise basal metabolism)
- {基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}が{高|たか}い (to have a high basal metabolism)
- {基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}{量|りょう} (basal metabolic rate)
